items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve been studying a Don Sebesky score lately

ctx.x: Do you have any predictions — when your trombone player called you and said gee this could be the end for me as a musician, do you have a prediction about that?

I think it depends on the person and how we handled it. Like for me, even if I was to stop playing in public it doesn’t mean that I stop playing you know. I’m still going to be like well for the past three months I’ve been at home mostly. Like I said I practice, I’ve been studying. Every morning I get up I scan music, I scan documents, I usually start my day by doing that then I go on to study a score. I’ve been studying a Don Sebesky score lately and a Thad Jones. What I do is I write it out you know, all the…
Excellent. I’m going to put that in capital letters when we do the transcript.
